method: Six paired deterministic matches per rules version: three seeds, default player team versus actual practice rival team, both seats. Practice rival uses choosePracticePlan; built-in chooseAIPlan substitutes for a human using default player loadouts. Every round strictly restored. No simulated timings represent gameplay performance.
limitations: Small deterministic sample, fixed rosters and default loadouts; not evidence of human enjoyment or global metagame balance.
Seat swaps are paired checks, not independent random trials.
No Frostbite or Deep Freeze appears in these default loadouts; Ice prevalence here measures reaction-created Ice only.
Field prevalence counts post-resolution cells; fields created and immediately expired within an exchange are not separately measured.
All conclusions compare these exact policies and fixtures; skilled human use of long Ice lanes or alternative loadouts needs playtesting.
